title: GitHub Copilot Fusion: Pricing and Limits (2026)
summary: GitHub Copilot Fusion is GitHub's new automation feature. After reading, you'll know what capabilities it adds and how they apply to your workflows.
body_markdown:
## Compare Copilot Fusion cost and speed to alternatives


As of 2026-10-31, Fusion can't be ranked on cost or speed. Neighbouring plans publish prices, and none of the options compared here publishes a speed figure a workflow could be timed against.

### Copilot Fusion pricing per seat and per use


On GitHub's[plans page](https://github.com/features/copilot/plans) , Copilot Pro is listed at **$10 per month** and Max at $100 per month. Those are ranges, so budget at the top figure until a checkout says otherwise.


Google's[Gemini subscriptions page](https://gemini.google/subscriptions) lists AI Plus at $4.99, AI Pro at $19.99 and AI Ultra at $99.99 per month, so the tier you choose determines your monthly cost.


A team already on AI Pro pays more than Copilot Pro's top figure and far less than Max's floor.


Anthropic's[pricing page](https://claude.com/pricing) shows a $0[Claude](https://claude.com/pricing) Free plan with limited usage every 5 hours, a free baseline for testing before anyone pays.


The table sets Fusion beside both. Read the "not published" cells as the finding, because those are the numbers you can't budget or schedule around.

Without a Fusion price, any pilot's cost is an assumption you'd be writing yourself.


**No speed comparison can honestly be made today** . GitHub publishes no Fusion figure, and the other pages cited here publish none either. Any ranking would be invented.


Timestamp the moment your flow receives the event and the moment the result lands, then compare those intervals against your current assistant on the same task.
